name: formula_ticking
description: Formula aggregation of task 4.1d on a keyed input table, with the updates Java delivered: both forms with and without keys, formulas of one and of several columns, of a key column, of no column, with a vector result, beside a group aggregation in either order and beside other aggregations, as rows join and leave groups, values are modified, keys change, groups empty and refill, and the table empties and refills. The steps are those of rest_ticking.
